title: The Dangerous Deed
coreMove: Crisis becomes useful only when it forces honest inventory, because a collapsed life needs structural renewal before stronger output can matter.

exampleSpecs.stakes: growth can hide collapse when status becomes identity
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the penthouse window as a warning before accepting more pressure

exampleSpecs.stakes: legal and reputational pressure can turn work into self-erasure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn the contested company pressure into a boundary decision

exampleSpecs.stakes: fatigue can become invisible when achievement keeps rewarding it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect the entrepreneur's collapse to body, mind, heart, and values

exampleSpecs.stakes: trying to repair reputation too fast can deepen the old damage
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use public humiliation as a cue for agency instead of overwork

exampleSpecs.audience: professionals whose home life is absorbing career damage
exampleSpecs.stakes: a career battle can spread into the relationships that should help recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Tie the career battlefield to values repair

exampleSpecs.audience: students using achievement to cover distress
exampleSpecs.stakes: discipline can become harmful if it avoids deeper support
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Avoid treating early rising as a cure for serious distress
